correctness.rationale: The object and quantifiers were reconstructed directly. A normalized exhaustive search over all \(64\) possible columns excludes size \(10\) and enumerates exactly \(648\) size-\(9\) maxima containing \(000\). Expansion under a transitive \(64\)-element translation subgroup gives exactly \(4608\) literal maxima, independently checked by \(4608\cdot9=648\cdot64\). Applying all \(82944\) row/symbol symmetries to one representative produces exactly the same \(4608\) sets, yielding stabilizer \(18\). Direct checks over all maxima verify the multiplicity and Hamming profiles. A separate mixed-integer model with all \(8640\) forbidden-triple constraints independently returned optimum \(9\).

value.rationale: The case \(q=4\) is the first alphabet size strictly larger than the strength in the central three-row function \(p_3(3,q)\). The result is not merely a recomputation of a known witness: it supplies the complete equality structure, showing \(4608\) literal maxima collapse to one standard row/symbol-equivalence orbit and forcing exact coordinate and distance profiles. This is a natural finite benchmark for the same extremal family whose asymptotics motivated later work.
